names: Geoawesome (geoawesome.com; YouTube @geoawesome.digital), geospatial media and community
Awesome GEE Community Catalog (gee-community-catalog.org; Earth Engine Data Catalog, community/sat-io), geospatial datasets
'GEO' as the archive's own series code for the Geocoded Basin (EA-GEO-01, #689; its addendum #77): a homonym of the string inside the archive, on no card
homonyms.basis: the MMRS record's disambiguation (Geoawesome: 'geospatial media, GIS, Earth observation'; the catalog: 'Google Earth Engine, community geospatial datasets') and negative tag ('NOT a geospatial ('geo') awesome list'); the Capture Registry's finding (CAP-1-06); the cards B2, B5, B8, B9, B10; the encyclopedia's report that 'GEO' can be confused with geography (F45). The other GEO lists (amplifying-ai/awesome-generative-engine-optimization, henu-wang/awesome-geo, aGEO at geo.deeflect.com) share the name or the class and are distinct entities, kept as relations and census candidates, never senses of the name. The archive-side homonym was found in the string pass and set aside (reading.json).

captures.description: AWESOME-GEO, THE BARE STRING, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'most commonly refers to curated collections and resources dedicated to Generative Engine Optimization'; three repositories and one platform (DavidHuji/Awesome-GEO, amplifying-ai/awesome-generative-engine-optimization, the aGEO platform by Dmitry Kargaev); then 'Alternative Meanings': Geoawesome (geospatial media) and the Awesome GEE Community Catalog (Earth Engine datasets). Ten cards across all of them, with henu-wang/awesome among the cards.

atoms.evidence: An active research and resource list featuring academic papers (such as IF-GEO and multimodal rank manipulation studies) and open-source tools.
